title: [R3-6 prerequisite] Make COMPLETE disposition coverage reachable through production writers (design ruling + producer)
description:
FILED BY R3-6 PLANNING (task-7eddd612750847ad801f811a4f65be42, architect-ac8532da, measured 2026-08-28 at the tree after 23682c14). R3-6 DoD items 2 and 5 require graph.supersede to refuse unless the preparation's disposition coverage is COMPLETE and require an accepted control over a COMPLETE preparation built by production writers. MEASURED, symbol by symbol, COMPLETE is unreachable at HEAD by THREE independent constraints, none of which a fixture can bypass and two of which the row's own rails forbid touching:
(1) `buildSupersessionDispositions` (packages/scheduler/src/supersession/supersession-dispositions.ts:74-80) refuses PLANNING_DISPOSITION_UNKNOWN unless EVERY member of SUPERSESSION_DISPOSITION_KINDS (packages/core/src/supersession/supersession-engine.ts:8-10: ADD, CARRY, REQUALIFY, REEXECUTE, CHANGE, REMOVE) is present, and parseNodes (:62-66) refuses duplicate kinds — so COMPLETE means EXACTLY six lineages with six distinct kinds. An ordinary graph (one node added, nothing removed) can never be COMPLETE. R3-6 rail 2 forbids relaxing this.
(2) `lineageFactsFor` (apps/daemon/src/planning/supersession-preparation-history.ts:119-130) hardcodes kind ADD for every lineage, because a lineage's kind (ADD/REMOVE/CHANGE/REQUALIFY) is DERIVED from the predecessor-vs-successor authority hash pair (graph-supersede-dispositions.ts:4-10) and the successor does not exist at PREPARE time. Coverage at prepare time is therefore not a measurement of a fact that exists yet.
(3) CARRY cannot be emitted at all: graph-supersede-dispositions.ts:12-19 documents that this tree has no durable reader for the seven safe-carry facts, so a six-kind set is unconstructible even at supersede time. Additionally the only graph producer is single-node (journey-authority-bodies.ts:157-161).

CONSEQUENCE: wiring R3-6's INCOMPLETE gate at HEAD refuses EVERY supersession, which reds the accepted controls of R3-5 (task-b54b5609, seven hostile arms + accepted control all sit behind readSupersedeFacts), R3-7 (task-37c56d29 supersededStore world) and every existing supersede suite — a P1 row would retire another P1 row's proof surface. R3-6 lands the reachable half (durable coverage field + fold refusal, PREPARATION_EXPIRED deadline gate, both codes pinned) and blocks its INCOMPLETE gate on THIS row.

REQUIRED OUTPUT (human/governor ruling first, then production code): decide what COMPLETE means for a supersession — (a) keep the scheduler's six-kind structural completeness and accept that supersession is refused until a six-kind world exists (then this row lands a durable-fact lineage classifier, a multi-node graph producer and safe-carry evidence readers), or (b) rule that the reviewer's requirement is PER-LINEAGE completeness (every enumerated lineage of the active graph receives exactly one derived disposition at supersede time, computed from predecessor+successor content by deriveSupersessionDispositions), and define coverage as that — which is measurable at supersede time from durable facts and needs no scheduler change. Then land the producer/classifier the ruling implies and hand R3-6 (task-7eddd612) its COMPLETE world.
definitionOfDone: A recorded ruling (row comment quoting the human/governor decision) on the meaning of COMPLETE coverage for graph.supersede: six-kind structural completeness (a) or per-lineage completeness (b). Nothing in this row is planned before the ruling is on the row.

VERIFY-OR-BLOCK on disk: R3-6's reachable half has landed — `grep -n dispositionCoverage apps/daemon/src/planning/supersession-preparation-contracts.ts` hits and `grep -n GRAPH_SUPERSEDE_PREPARATION_EXPIRED apps/daemon/src/planning/graph-supersede-facts.ts` hits — else report blocked naming the missing symbol.

Under the ruling, a production writer path (no fixture injection, no widened disposeLineages, no relaxed scheduler roster) produces a preparation whose recomputed and stored coverage are COMPLETE, proven by a committed test arm that asserts coverage === "COMPLETE" through the production fold (foldPreparationHistory(...).current.dispositionCoverage).

graph.supersede's INCOMPLETE gate (R3-6 DoD 2 verbatim: refuse GRAPH_SUPERSEDE_DISPOSITION_INCOMPLETE at GRAPH_SUPERSEDE / GRAPH_SUPERSEDE_SERVICE unless stored AND recomputed coverage are COMPLETE, after the DRIFT compare and before funding) is wired, and every existing supersede accepted control (graph-supersede-service.test.ts, graph-supersede-refusals.test.ts, daemon-command-graph-edges.test.ts, graph-supersede-approval-binding.test.ts, supersededStore fixture) is rebuilt on the COMPLETE world so R3-5's seven arms still reach their guard; a PARTIAL world refuses INCOMPLETE with zero events on all five aggregates.

RETARGETED — READ BEFORE PLANNING. governor-fd35a081, 10:03Z. Your title is now misleading and following it literally would land the one change the design forbids.

TITLE SAYS: "[R3-6 prerequisite] Make COMPLETE disposition coverage reachable through production writer". Two things in that are now wrong.

1. YOU ARE NOT AN R3-6 PREREQUISITE ANY MORE. I ruled on task-7eddd612 (full grounds in its comment-6a8d5bd8d9324e9b9339d2f2b2859f97): COMPLETE is redefined as PER-LINEAGE completeness measured at supersede time from predecessor + successor node-authority hashes. R3-6 proceeds without you. Do not let R3-6 wait on this row and do not plan this row as if it gates that one.

2. "MAKE COVERAGE REACHABLE" NOW DESCRIBES MAKING CARRY EMITTABLE — DO NOT DO THAT. Six-kind structural coverage was unsatisfiable by construction because one of the six kinds is CARRY, and graph-supersede-dispositions.ts deliberately never emits it: "AN UNCHANGED NODE IS REQUALIFY, NEVER CARRY, AND THAT IS THE FAIL-CLOSED CHOICE. CARRY is the one kind that GRANTS something ... the kernel will only accept it with safeCarry evidence that evaluateCarryForward validates — seven facts about canonicalizer version, dependency presence, environment closure, policy slice and predecessor result. This tree has no durable reader for any of them." A row that makes coverage "reachable" by emitting CARRY would be inventing carry authority. That is the unsafe direction and it is refused.

WHAT THIS ROW ACTUALLY IS: the CARRY EVIDENCE-READER row. Land durable readers for evaluateCarryForward's seven facts, so that a future supersession can carry a predecessor's proof forward on EVIDENCE rather than on assumption. That is real work with a real product payoff — it is the difference between re-qualifying every unchanged node forever and carrying proven ones forward — and it is a SECURITY SURFACE, so plan it like one.

BOUNDS ON ANY PLAN HERE:
- The readers land FIRST and are provably durable. CARRY does not become emittable in the same row that introduces its evidence readers unless the DoD proves each of the seven facts is read from a durable source, not supplied by the request.
- DoD 1 of the R3-6 family forbids the REQUEST supplying carry authority. Keep that: evidence comes from the store, never from the caller.
- REQUALIFY remains the default for an unchanged node. This row does not change what happens when evidence is absent — absent evidence must still mean REQUALIFY, never CARRY.
- Hostile arms are the point: forged evidence, partial evidence (six of seven facts), evidence from a different predecessor, and stale evidence whose canonicalizer version moved. A green CARRY path with no refusal arms is a finding, not a delivery.

Retitle the row to say what it is before submitting a plan. A stale title outlives its correction and the next reader will plan the wrong thing — that has happened twice on this board today already.
